newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Swedish FinMin concerned about Europe yield rises.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin concerned about Europe yield rises.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink expressed concern about Monday's increases in European debt yields.
He noted that yields had risen across Europe, not only in Sweden where the 10-year bond yield closed 13 basis points higher at 7.21 percent.
"There has been a sharp rise in Sweden and internationally," he said in response to questions from journalists. "There is concern on the markets. We are affected by it."
"And of course such sharp yield movements is something one has reason to feel concern about," he added.
Asbrink said it was difficult to tell what had caused yields to rise in the afternoon.
Earlier on Monday, Asbrink said he was not "particularly worried" about the recent weakness of the crown.
